a13_t-0000527.text: 8 plus 38, okay, CapCom. Go up with that, please.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: 13, Houston. Level sense arm time, 8 plus 38 nominal; S-II cut-off time, 9 plus 48. Over. [Pause.]

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0000527.text: Roger. Nominal on the level sense arm, 9:48 on the S-II cut-off.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: Stand by for S-IVB to orbit capability.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: That's affirmative, and stand by for S-IVB to orbit.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: You have S-IVB to orbit, Jim.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0000527.text: Roger. We have S-IVB to orbit. [Long pause.]

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0000527.text: Okay, we're 1,400 feet a second low on V i . That's not too bad.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: We're Go, Flight, with engine five out early.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: Okay, shouldn't be any problem. Your first thoughts here on TLI, should it?

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: We'll have to check it, Flight.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0000527.text: We're right at 8 [garble] - H-dot is a little bit low; V i is low, but that's understandable.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0000527.text: You're S-IVB to orbit capability now.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: 13, Houston. Looking good at 8 minutes. [Long pause.]

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0000527.text: How's those systems, Fred? Are there any...

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0000527.text: Okay, now, H-dot is low, Jim [garble]. S-IVB ought to pick you up.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0000527.text: Yes. Hey, I got a - We got a funny vibration

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0000527.text: Yes. Yes, there was a bit of noise, there. Yes.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: Apollo 13, Houston. Mark, level sense arm.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: We're Go at 9, CapCom and the CMC's Go.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: Apollo 13, Houston. At 9 minutes, you're Go; the CMC is Go.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: Okay, we're Go for staging, CapCom.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: 13, Houston. You are Go for staging.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: Flight, this is RSO. We allow the S-II to burn through the gate.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: Stand by for Mode IV capability.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: Apollo 13, Houston. Stand by for mode IV capability.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: Roger that, Jim. Thrust looks good.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: [Garble] Guidance and the CMC is Go, CapCom.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: 13, Houston. You're looking good. Trajectory, guidance, CMC are all Go.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0000527.text: Right on 8; good on H-dot; 200 feet a second low on V isp .

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0000527.text: Yes, I got that. Mode IV.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: EECOM, GNC, how do you all...?

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0000527.text: We're looking good, Jim; trajectory's looking good.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: We should have TLI capability, Flight.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: 13, Houston. At 11 minutes, you're Go. Predicted cut-off on the S-IVB is 12 plus 34. Over. [Long pause.]

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: And Booster, understand that your first cut is that you should be able to make TLI.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0000527.text: Okay, going to [garble] dead band now, guys. We're 102.5 - shutdown velocity...

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: Flight, FIDO, we've got good agreement. All sources. We're Go.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000527.text: It's still not looking very good. It's really noisy right now, Flight. We'll have to evaluate it later.

a13_t-0000527.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000527.text: Apollo 13, Houston. You're Go at 11½, and predicted cut-off time is 12 plus 34. Over. [Pause.]

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Stand by for Mode IV capability.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. Stand by for mode IV capability.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Roger that, Jim. Thrust looks good.

a13_t-0000805ag.text: [Garble] Guidance and the CMC is Go, CapCom.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000805ag.text: 13, Houston. You're looking good. Trajectory, guidance, CMC are all Go.

a13_t-0000805ag.text: Right on 8; good on H-dot; 200 feet a second low on V isp .

a13_t-0000805ag.text: Yes, I got that. Mode IV.

a13_t-0000805ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. You're Go at 11½, and predicted cut-off time is 12 plus 34. Over. [Pause.]

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Okay - Do we shut down at - Freddo?

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0000805ag.text: [Garble] you get the last page, Jack; you got the clean-up stuff.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0000805ag.text: All the systems stuff. You got to [garble] SECO.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0000805ag.text: I'm going to just jump right in [garble].

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Copy SECO, Jim. We're looking at the DSKY.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: We've got a Go orbit, all sources, and the booster has been safed.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Okay, CapCom. The orbit's Go, The booster's safe.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. You have a Go orbit all sources, and the booster is safe. Over.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Go orbit and the booster is safe. Thank you, Joe.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Okay, Guidance. You see the - is it too early yet for the Verb 66, 45?

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: He hasn't completed it yet, Flight. He's getting it set up at this time. Terminated P11 and he's working on it.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Okay. Booster, How's the S-IVB look?

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Looks good, Flight. We're just about configured for it, but I'll be right back with you.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: The Saturn's configured for orbit and we're Go.

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Okay. No problems at all on the Saturn. Is that right?

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. I have your Z torqueing angle. You ready? [Pause.]

a13_t-0000805ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0000805ag.text: Jack is ready to copy, Joe.

a13_0001000.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0001000.text: Roger that, Jim. Thrust looks good.

a13_0001000.speaker: Flight loop
a13_0001000.text: [Garble] Guidance and the CMC is Go, CapCom.

a13_0001000.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0001000.text: 13, Houston. You're looking good. Trajectory, guidance, CMC are all Go.

a13_0001000.text: Right on 8; good on H-dot; 200 feet a second low on V isp .

a13_0001000.speaker: Haise
a13_0001000.text: Yes, I got that. Mode IV.

a13_0001000.text: We're looking good, Jim; trajectory's looking good.

a13_0001000.text: Okay - Do we shut down at - Freddo?

a13_0001000.text: All the systems stuff. You got to [garble] SECO.

a13_0001000.text: I'm going to just jump right in [garble].

a13_0001000.text: Copy SECO, Jim. We're looking at the DSKY.

a13_0001000.text: We've got a Go orbit, all sources, and the booster has been safed.

a13_t-0000958.text: Roger that, Jim. Thrust looks good.

a13_t-0000958.text: [Garble] Guidance and the CMC is Go, CapCom.

a13_t-0000958.text: 13, Houston. You're looking good. Trajectory, guidance, CMC are all Go.

a13_t-0000958.text: Right on 8; good on H-dot; 200 feet a second low on V isp .

a13_t-0000958.text: Yes, I got that. Mode IV.

a13_t-0000958.text: EECOM, GNC, how do you all...?

a13_t-0001411ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0001411ag.text: The Saturn's configured for orbit and we're Go.

a13_t-0001411ag.speaker: Flight loop
a13_t-0001411ag.text: Okay. No problems at all on the Saturn. Is that right?

a13_t-0001411ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. I have your Z torqueing angle. You ready? [Pause.]

a13_t-0001411ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0001411ag.text: Jack is ready to copy, Joe.

a13_0001457.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0001457.text: Apollo 13, Houston. Your preliminary orbit down here is 102.5 times 100.3 [nautical miles, 189.8 by 185.8 km], and everything is looking good.

a13_0001457.speaker: Lovell
a13_0001457.text: Roger, Houston. And it looks good to be up here again.

a13_t-0001457.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0001457.text: Apollo 13, Houston. I have your Z torqueing angle. You ready? [Pause.]

a13_t-0001457.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0001457.text: Jack is ready to copy, Joe.

a13_0002127.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0002127.text: Apollo 13, Houston.

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Go ahead, Houston.

a13_0002127.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0002127.text: Okay. Couple minutes to LOS, Jim. Everything is looking real good. Your AOS time at Carnarvon will be 52:36, and we don't have too much of a handle on why the inboard cut off early except that it apparently was an engine problem and not a switch select function. But we're certain that you'll be able to make TLI based on what we're looking at now.

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Roger. There's nothing like an interesting launch.

a13_0002127.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0002127.text: That's right. [Long pause.]

a13_0002127.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0002127.text: Apollo 13, Houston. Canary LOS in 30 seconds. Request Command Reset, please.

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Roger. Command Reset coming on.

a13_0002127.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0002127.text: Thank you. [Long pause.]

a13_0002127.speaker: Swigert
a13_0002127.text: Hey, you guys, are you ready? I've done my other item there; I'm ready to give you - [garble].

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Well, all right, fine. Let's just get this one done first.

a13_0002127.speaker: Swigert
a13_0002127.text: Okay.

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: What else do you have to do here?

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: Okay. Going Bit Rate.

a13_0002127.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0002127.text: Apollo 13, Houston. Request Low Bit Rate, please. Over.

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Low Bit Rate.

a13_0002127.speaker: Unidentifiable crewmember
a13_0002127.text: Okay.

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Okay. The pressure's okay?

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: Yes. Let's see now, Jim, there's one more reading there; you gave me the - you gave me the helium pressure, 4100. What's the manifold pressure on that one?

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: The manifold pressure is reading about 80.

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: Eighty? Okay, give me the number 1, then.

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Okay, number 1. And helium temperature is 80, helium pressure is 4100, and the manifold pressure is about 100.

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: Manifold's about 100. Okay.

a13_0002127.speaker: Swigert
a13_0002127.text: Okay, Freddo. Have a look - the cabin and suit doing? Before we...

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: They're both pretty equal, now, at about 5/5.

a13_0002127.speaker: Swigert/Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Okay.

a13_0002127.speaker: Lovell
a13_0002127.text: Well, let's - We'll break the [garble]

a13_0002127.speaker: Swigert
a13_0002127.text: Okay, let's do it. Freddo, here's your bag.

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: Okay. Jim.

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: Okay, for that item, those two I can check off. You got the Z-torquing angle?

a13_0002127.speaker: Swigert
a13_0002127.text: Yes.

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: I've checked the caution and warning; you've done that. We're up - we're up to item 9.

a13_0002127.speaker: Swigert
a13_0002127.text: How we doing time line?

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: We're a little behind, but it's the kind of stuff that we can catch up lickety-split with.

a13_0002127.speaker: Swigert
a13_0002127.text: Okay.

a13_0002127.speaker: Haise
a13_0002127.text: Okay. Let me get - make sure I got this item. I want A, Simplex. Hell, it was already there. B to Off. No, it wasn't. It's just a hard switch again. They really fake you out, these switches...

a13_t-0002500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002500.text: Compared with the simulator. Okay, let me check item 13 off; I've completed that one. Let's see.

a13_t-0002500.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002500.text: Jack, be careful in your movements now.

a13_t-0002500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002500.text: Yes. I'm not having any problems so far.

a13_t-0002500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002500.text: PCM Bit Rate is Low. I did the Command Reset in Normal. I'll do it again, just to make sure. I have an A, Simplex, and B, Off. That's great. Jack, could you hand me one thing?

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: And also, you might be able, if your eyes become accustomed to it - you might be able to see the - the airglow. There, you can. You can see the airglow.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: I can see that lightning, too.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Oh, I - I won't be able to see [garble]

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes, but see the - Antares is in the airglow layer.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes, it is. Right in it.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: And then right below that, way - about a half a degree, that's...

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: So, if you lift the lights, we'll see again.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay, I'm ready for the main Reg check, Fred, if you're ready.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay. Go ahead. I'll tell you when. [Garble] just call it on.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay. Main Reg B going closed. Emergency Cabin Pressure selector 1, Push To Test.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Main Reg B valve, Open; A going closed.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Cabin - Cabin Pressure selector 2, Push To Test.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Main Reg valve B ... or A, Open, and Emergency Cabin Pressure selector, closed. Okay, Jim. I got to get to ... to those [garble] here.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: You're kidding. I thought you said the helmet was tough to get in this bag. Piece of cake. Have you got - have you got one of those big helmets?

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes - No, I don't think - unless I got a bigger head.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: You don't have a Borman special, do you?

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Maybe your damn bag won't fit anymore with that one [garble] have to slip it in this one.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes. [garble] a little bit. I got a [garble]

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Well, is there anything else we can be doing right now? Like COAS?

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: ...you can get out the ORDEAL box, if you could...

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: I'm going to try it right now.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: That would save me a trip down under there.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: You got to watch the time right now for...

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: I don't - I got to go stow my water wings. You guys got your water wings on?

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: No. I don't think I'm going to fiddle with that right now, Jack. They're not in my way.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes. I'll trade. We can get that later.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Well, I'll tell you what - I blew mine on 8.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes. But you were the guy that - Jack should take his off. He's the guy moving around.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Man, I'll tell you, that first stage...

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: When that shut down, man, I thought I was going through the instrument panel. I'll tell you, that was - I was so surprised [garble] I had heard about it.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay, let's see. Confirm normal, we've done that. We've stowed the water wings. Now it's the TSB is the only item left outstanding there.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay, I have the ORDEAL in place. Now, do you want the camera bracket?

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes, you better leave that camera bracket up there.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes. Yes, I can feel a little bit of the zero-g effect, a little flushing in the face.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes, that's that - Your blood rushes to your head because your heart doesn't have anything to pump against.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Yes, I can feel that, too.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay, I have the camera bracket.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay, have you got the - the ORDEAL mounted? I have...

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay, Jim. Are you ready to get busy on getting the RADs on the line?

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay, Glycol Reservoir Bypass valve to Open.

a13_t-0002505ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002505ag.text: Okay, now we need a little bit of quantity in the Accum - not the Accum, but we need the fuel valve on for about 5 percent on down to 45 percent. That's about what it was in the [garble], too.

a13_t-0002919ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0002919ag.text: So, if you lift the lights, we'll see again.

a13_t-0002919ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002919ag.text: Okay, I'm ready for the main Reg check, Fred, if you're ready.

a13_t-0002919ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0002919ag.text: Okay. Go ahead. I'll tell you when. [Garble] just call it on.

a13_t-0002919ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002919ag.text: Okay. Main Reg B going closed. Emergency Cabin Pressure selector 1, Push To Test.

a13_t-0002919ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0002919ag.text: Main Reg B valve, Open; A going closed.

a13_t-0003458.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0003458.text: I am giving you the sequence camera here, Jim.

a13_t-0003458.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0003458.text: I tell you, I haven't checked the setting.

a13_t-0003458.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0003458.text: I've got them unstowed. Now. [garble] that'd be 32.

a13_t-0003458.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0003458.text: Thank you. Okay, 18 millimeter, f:8, and 250th.

a13_t-0003458.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0003458.text: Now, let's see. Let me give you a - it's f:8, 250th, 7 feet, 12 frames per second.

a13_t-0003957.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0003957.text: Let me know when you turn them on. I only need about 5 percent; I don't need much.

a13_t-0003957.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0003957.text: Okay, let me look a minute, here; I have to stabilize.

a13_t-0003957.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0003957.text: [Garble] back down there [garble] go to Off.

a13_t-0003957.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0003957.text: It's right at 50, though; the hell with it, that's good.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay. Starting my watch. It's on Secondary.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay, you've got to leave it there for 30 seconds.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay, that's it; put it back to close or off or wherever it...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay, I'm on page 2-14; coming up to EPS monitor check...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: You got to do a GDC align...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: You've got the sequence camera bracket and the ORDEAL, right?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: And those are all mounted, and we're all running on...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Yes. Okay, better record this down [garble]...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: I ain't got - I ain't going to let that pass, man...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: I'll give you a gold - gold star.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: [Garble] got all that in your book, Jack?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Yes. I'm going to write it on a [garble] here.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: I'll do a GDC align now, Fred.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay. Now I'm here, I'm going to go ahead and [garble] the secondary loop. Okay, Secondary Loop is coming on line, gang; AC-1...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay. Do we have to wait for MSFN to torque this?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: That's that little extra whining you hear, and it's the Secondary Loop.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: I can see the sludges in the [garble] burn.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay. So that one is done, done...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Do I need a - to get MSFN? I don't need them to torque here, do I?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: I don't think so - Wait - Where are the torquing angles [garble]?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: I've got the torqueing angles; let's see - [garble] - and it's 0.162 which is quite a bit less than - [garbled]

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay, Jack, did you ever get my Main B breaker in down there?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Yes, I did, in your COAS?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: And - let me verify that the RADs and REACS CB sticks are out, and - off.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay. I'll verify the Main Bus Ties are Off...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: GDC's aligned. 46 now. How we doing on the time line, Fred?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Let's see, we're not - we're coming up 6 minutes - What we got to do is get the cameras ... get the TV camera out next. We're about fixed.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: 01:05 is when I got to start playing with the TV.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: After we get our HSK LOS.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: If you have time, I would suggest that you adjust your straps and strap it in again for TLI ... just to make sure you got them okay.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay. Still pressing on in here, and Jack's got to do that [garble]; I'll circle it.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay, what do you have to do?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: The RADs and REAC breakers, six of them, out [garble].

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Rad, Reac, Reac, Reac - Okay, I can verify three Rads and three Reacs out.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: And, Jack, you want to put tool E down there on the handhold - toward the handhold?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Yes. I think I can get closer than that and [garble].

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay, I've got the horizon out there and I've got the airglow layer [garble].

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay, and we got the relay bus selected [garble] - I got to get this TSB [garble]. Okay, item 15's done. And that makes one outstanding item, and I've got a couple from a few pages back.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Right there. Unstow and mount TSBs - they're in A-1. [Garble] down below. Hey, where do these - these guys go? They go right in the pocket of this L-shaped bag, don't they?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: I thought they went right behind you.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay. I'm up the [garble] monitor - [garble] look good - H 2 flow - [garble].

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay, I ought to be getting down there - [garble]. How you doing, Jack?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Good. Hey, how about that - Do you need - that Secondary RAD valve?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: We got the secondary - we made the secondary check; the filters finally came out a little bit...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: ...and the ORDEAL's already out; the COAS is...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Jim, do you need a TSB?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: [Garble] a big one. Let's see; where did we stow TSBs? We want to [garble]

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Jack, whenever you get time, if you - want to slow down a little bit, well, just come back and we'll take these lifevests off and get this stowed out of the way.

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Okay. I'll be ready to do it whenever you...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Once you get one of them in...

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004300ag.text: How you doing, Jack? [Garble] all right down there?

a13_t-0004300ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004300ag.text: Oh, yes. No problems yet. [Garble] kind of worried [garble] 12.1 down [garble].

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004500.text: Stand by.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: Do I need a - to get MSFN? I don't need them to torque here, do I?

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004500.text: I don't think so - Wait - Where are the torquing angles [garble]?

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: I've got the torqueing angles; let's see - [garble] - and it's 0.162 which is quite a bit less than - [garbled]

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay, Jack, did you ever get my Main B breaker in down there?

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: Yes, I did, in your COAS?

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Yes.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: Main B? I did.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Yes. That's right.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: That's done.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: And - let me verify that the RADs and REACS CB sticks are out, and - off.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay. [Garble.]

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay. I'll verify the Main Bus Ties are Off...

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004500.text: GDC's aligned. 46 now. How we doing on the time line, Fred?

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Let's see, we're not - we're coming up 6 minutes - What we got to do is get the cameras ... get the TV camera out next. We're about fixed.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: 01:05 is when I got to start playing with the TV.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: After we get our HSK LOS.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: [Garble.]

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004500.text: If you have time, I would suggest that you adjust your straps and strap it in again for TLI ... just to make sure you got them okay.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay. Still pressing on in here, and Jack's got to do that [garble]; I'll circle it.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay, what do you have to do?

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: The RADs and REAC breakers, six of them, out [garble].

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004500.text: Rad, Reac, Reac, Reac - Okay, I can verify three Rads and three Reacs out.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay, good show.

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Main A-1 - Main A-2...

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004500.text: Okay. Bus voltage [garble].

a13_t-0004500.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004500.text: And, Jack, you want to put tool E down there on the handhold - toward the handhold?

a13_t-0004701ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004701ag.text: And, Jack, you want to put tool E down there on the handhold - toward the handhold?

a13_t-0004701ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0004701ag.text: Yes. I think I can get closer than that and [garble].

a13_t-0004701ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004701ag.text: Okay, I've got the horizon out there and I've got the airglow layer [garble].

a13_t-0004701ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004701ag.text: Okay, and we got the relay bus selected [garble] - I got to get this TSB [garble]. Okay, item 15's done. And that makes one outstanding item, and I've got a couple from a few pages back.

a13_t-0004701ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004701ag.text: Right there. Unstow and mount TSBs - they're in A-1. [Garble] down below. Hey, where do these - these guys go? They go right in the pocket of this L-shaped bag, don't they?

a13_t-0004701ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0004701ag.text: I thought they went right behind you.

a13_t-0004701ag.speaker: Haise
a13_t-0004701ag.text: Okay. I'm up the [garble] monitor - [garble] look good - H 2 flow - [garble].

a13_0005200.speaker: Haise
a13_0005200.text: I think we ought to be having AOS, gang; we've got...

a13_0005200.speaker: Haise
a13_0005200.text: Okay. I - Let me call them.

a13_0005200.speaker: Haise
a13_0005200.text: Look at me, Jack; I show gain.

a13_0005200.speaker: Swigert
a13_0005200.text: Okay, Joe. Everything is going good. We're proceeding on the time line in good fashion. I've got a P52 done. I can give you the torqueing angles.

a13_0005200.speaker: Swigert
a13_0005200.text: Okay. Used Noun 26 - stars 26 and 33. The star angle difference was all balls. Noun 93: minus 067, minus all balls, plus 0.162. The time of torqueing was 45 minutes, 35 seconds.

a13_0005200.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0005200.text: Ah, well, that sounds marginally acceptable.

a13_0005200.speaker: Swigert
a13_0005200.text: For a new CMP, it ain't too bad.

a13_0005200.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0005200.text: Yeah. Okay, 13. We've got nothing for you at the moment. Everything's looking good. We're looking at your data now.

a13_0005715.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0005715.text: Apollo 13, Houston. LOS Carnarvon in about 30 seconds. Honeysuckle on the hour, and verify your S-band is up for Honeysuckle. Over.

a13_0005715.speaker: Lovell
a13_0005715.text: And, Houston, we're beginning to see a beautiful sunrise here.

a13_t-0010000.speaker: Lovell
a13_t-0010000.text: Roger, Houston; 13 here. Reading you loud and clear.

a13_0010321.speaker: Haise
a13_0010321.text: [Very weak.] Ah, Houston, 13.

a13_0010321.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0010321.text: Go ahead, 13.

a13_0010321.speaker: Haise
a13_0010321.text: Would it be okay if I crank up the FM [garble]?

a13_0010321.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0010321.text: You're coming in weak. I didn't quite copy it.

a13_0010321.speaker: Haise
a13_0010321.text: Would it be okay, Joe, if we crank up the FM after we leave Honeysuckle here?

a13_0010321.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0010321.text: Oh. Stand by on that one. [Long pause.]

a13_0010321.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0010321.text: 13, Houston.

a13_0010321.speaker: Lovell
a13_0010321.text: Go ahead, Houston.

a13_0010321.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0010321.text: What TV was that? [Pause.] Okay, 13...

a13_0010321.speaker: Haise
a13_0010321.text: Okay, Joe. I just wanted to put on the TV switch at Honeysuckle to tune her up there.

a13_0010321.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0010321.text: Roger. I'm being prompted, and you've got a Go for that. You can turn it on, go to TV, and we'll see you that way over the States.

a13_0010321.speaker: Haise
a13_0010321.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a13_0010321.speaker: Lovell
a13_0010321.text: Fred, I'll read the PADs, or you read the PADs, or somebody read the PADs.

a13_0010321.speaker: Swigert
a13_0010321.text: Hey, can I get a - a TV [garble]?

a13_0010321.speaker: Haise
a13_0010321.text: Oh, yes, Jack. LOS Carnarvon.

a13_0010321.speaker: Lovell
a13_0010321.text: Okay. 1:45, 75 [garble] LOS at - [garble].

a13_0010321.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0010321.text: Okay. 13, Houston. LOS Honeysuckle in about 30 seconds, and we'll see you over the States at 1 plus 28 plus 43. [Long pause.]

a13_0010321.speaker: Lovell
a13_0010321.text: Okay, coming up. [garble].

a13_0010321.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0010321.text: 13, Houston. Did you copy your AOS time?

a13_0010321.speaker: Lovell
a13_0010321.text: Fred, I'll get them when we get all relaxed. I'll do that [garble].

a13_0010321.speaker: Swigert
a13_0010321.text: [Garble.]

a13_0010321.speaker: Lovell
a13_0010321.text: Hey, Jack, [garble].

a13_0010321.speaker: Haise
a13_0010321.text: [Garble.]

a13_0010321.speaker: Swigert
a13_0010321.text: Yes, I can - yes, I can do it, Freddo. [garble].

a13_t-0012749ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0012749ag.text: Hello there. We thought you were still up there.

a13_t-0012749ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0012749ag.text: And we're just coming up on Baja, and I've got the TV on. Do you want it?

a13_t-0012749ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0012749ag.text: I don't think we require it just yet, Jack, but we'll command it when we're ready. I believe they are dumping the tape now. The booster looks good. The spacecraft looks good on the few minutes' data we've had.

a13_t-0012749ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0012749ag.text: Jim finally let me look out.

a13_t-0012749ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0012749ag.text: Chained me to the LEB down there stowing things and unstowing things, and I finally got a chance to look out and see the world. [Long pause.]

a13_t-0012749ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0012749ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. I have the TLI plus 90, and lift-off plus 8 PADs whenever you're ready. [Long pause.]

a13_t-0012749ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0012749ag.text: Okay. Go ahead with the TLI PAD, Joe.

a13_t-0012749ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0012749ag.text: Okay. This is the TLI plus 90 PAD. SPS/G&N, 63825, minus 1.54, plus 1.32, 004:06:45.53, minus 0491.7, plus 0000.1, plus 6634.0, 180, 228, 001; H A is N/A; H P is plus 0017.9; 6652.2, 7:37, 6626.5, 26, 155.4, 15.7. Boresight star is Zeta Sagittarii; up, 08.0; right, 2.1; minus 22.81, minus 025.00, 1140.7, 34087, 013:32:14. Set stars; Arcturus, Denebola; roll, 044; pitch, 012; yaw, 025; no ullage. Over.

a13_0012800.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0012800.text: Apollo 13, Houston through Guaymas. Over. [No Answer.]

a13_0012800.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0012800.text: Apollo 13, Houston through Guaymas. Over. [No Answer.]

a13_t-0012957.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0012957.text: Hello there. We thought you were still up there.

a13_t-0012957.speaker: Swigert
a13_t-0012957.text: And we're just coming up on Baja, and I've got the TV on. Do you want it?

a13_t-0012957.speaker: Kerwin
a13_t-0012957.text: I don't think we require it just yet, Jack, but we'll command it when we're ready. I believe they are dumping the tape now. The booster looks good. The spacecraft looks good on the few minutes' data we've had.

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: Apollo 13, Houston.

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Go ahead, Houston.

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: Okay. The computer is yours, Jim.

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Thank you, [garble].

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: And you are Go for TLI. Huntsville reports that you have a 6-second propellant pad which is 3 seconds more than a 3-sigma case; so you're good on consumables. The IU is so good that we're not going to update it. The only change we have for you is in the TLI checklist. At 57 minutes, where you slew the FDAI to 18 degrees, we recommend 20 degrees there, and we recommend that you look for 8 degrees instead of 6 degrees at ignition. The S-IVB is riding on the top of its deadband.

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Understand; and just out of curiosity, was that engine-out to use up more S-IVB fuel?

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: The engine-out did cause you to use more S-IVB fuel - about a 10-second-longer burn; but you're still Go.

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Okay. Thank you. [Pause.]

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: And, 13, Houston. We're ready to support pyro arm and docking probe extension whenever you're ready. [Pause.]

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Okay, Houston. Docking probe has been extended and all indications are nominal. We're down to Pyro Arm now and we're getting ready.

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: Okay, Jim. [Pause.]

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Okay, Houston. My circuit breaker's armed - or closed; Sequential Logic, two, on and up and we're standing by [garble].

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: Okay, 13. You're Go for pyro arm. [Long pause.]

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: And, Houston, 13. Were you reading us?

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: Roger, 13. Go ahead.

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Roger. We have our Sequential Arm circuit breakers in and our Sequential Logic, two, on and up and we are just standing by for your confirmation for a Go.

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: Sorry, 13. You didn't copy. You are Go for pyro arm. Over.

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Okay; fine. Thank you.

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: Apollo 13, Houston.

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Go ahead, Houston.

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: About 2½ minutes to LOS, Jim, and your AOS at Carnarvon will be 2 plus 25 plus 50. Over. [Pause.]

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Roger. AOS at Carnarvon 2 plus 25 plus 50.

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: That's affirm.

a13_0014808.speaker: Lovell
a13_0014808.text: Roger.

a13_0014808.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0014808.text: Apollo 13, Houston. LOS in about 1 minute. At LOS we'd like Command Reset and then Normal.

a13_0022500.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022500.text: Okay, Joe. Read you loud and clear. We're sitting here monitoring time base 6. You can see countdown; we're 20 seconds away.

a13_0022500.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022500.text: Okay. We're just starting to get data, and everything still looks good to us.

a13_0022500.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022500.text: Hey, Joe. At 2 hours and 12 minutes, the O 2 Flow High light came on, and it's been pegged high ever since, so it's been on about 14 minutes now.

a13_0022500.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022500.text: Okay. Apollo 13, Houston. You have a Go for all systems, and the O 2 Flow High check is nominal with the Waste Tank Vent open at this time, and it's no sweat.

a13_0022500.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022500.text: Okay. Just wanted you all to check it for me.

a13_0022945.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022945.text: Apollo 13, Houston. We'll be losing data from Carnarvon in about 1 minute. We'll probably have voice through ARIA. Everything is hunky-dory, and we'll be listening for you to tell us how the burn goes.

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: Okay, this is 13. We're standing by, too.

a13_0022945.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022945.text: Apollo 13, Houston through ARIA. Just a comm check. Over.

a13_0022945.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022945.text: Okay, Jim. It's not the best, but we're reading you.

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: [Garble] and what are your FDAI angles [garble]?

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Okay, I've got 59 and 30. How's that? Okay?

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: Okay. Here, I'll get out the [garble].

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Okay. [Garble] pitching her down a little bit, right here.

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: Okay, you watch the - trajectory thrust?

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: It's right on V I ; we're right on V I .

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: We got to leave these open.

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Right on - right on; [garble] little bit higher [garble].

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Right on [garble]. Right on H-dot; we're right on 8.

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: Okay, we'll hold this down; we've got a little vibration.

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Right on at 30. A little bit high.

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: And, Houston, we're noticing a little vibration during this burn.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: 5:30 - 5 point - [garble] the same countdown, Jack, and then start counting up.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Okay, Jim, it's SCS TVC Servo Power 1, Off.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: PCM Bit Rate, I got Low. EMS Mode - Wait, let Jack get it. Minus 3.0.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Okay, Jack, you clean up the DSKY and eventually get the P00.

a13_0022945.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022945.text: 13, Houston. We'll have you through Hawaii in 3 minutes.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: So we're standing by until Jack gets through that - jazz...

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Okay, it's a Verb 66 Enter, Jack, after you get - after you get the P00. Wait until you get that.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Okay, now you all switch - En route , Jack, you got to do a couple of things.

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Okay. You - let me put this - put this up under here...

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: And we'll have to switch comm carriers so I can take this suit stuff off.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Yes. We'll have to take the suit power off.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: And what would be nice for you to do, Jack, if you can...

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Okay. What do you want me to do?

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: ... is, first of all, Waste Stowage Vent valve, Closed.

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Okay. I'll do that right now.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: I've got the High Gain Power, Off, and I'm getting - I've got those two breakers in on 225. Waste Stowage Vent valve is Closed.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Now, get the TV camera out from under there, will you?

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: And I'll be dickering with that...

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Thank you. May as well get me the monitor and all that jazz.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: And the bracket. I'll be fiddling and getting this baby ready.

a13_0022945.speaker: Swigert
a13_0022945.text: Okay, Freddo, now here's the monitor.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Okay. Got a - Thank you. Okay. [Garble.]

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Okay. Okay. The [garble] are off - done.

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: Okay, my Suit Power's going Off...

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: 13 through Hawaii. How do you read?

a13_0022945.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022945.text: 13, Houston. You're weak but clear; it'll probably get better in a second. We're standing by for the burn report.

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: Jack, we need the burn report just briefly.

a13_0022945.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022945.text: And 13, Houston. The Booster reports that everything looks good with the S-IV.

a13_0022945.speaker: Lovell
a13_0022945.text: Sounds good, Houston. The ride was very nominal. We a little vibration, though, during most of the run.

a13_0022945.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022945.text: Okay. We copied your call on that, Jim.

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Okay, Joe. The DSKY read 35560, plus 04445, plus 01769, and Delta-V C was minus 3.0.

a13_0022945.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0022945.text: Roger. You can't ask for much better than that. How about the burn time? Did you notice?

a13_0022945.speaker: Haise
a13_0022945.text: Okay. On my trusty watch, I had about 3¾ seconds long.

a13_0024834.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0024834.text: Okay. We have the S-IVB maneuver to Sep attitude commencing at 2 plus 56 plus 37. Duration of the maneuver: 4 minutes. Sep time, 3 plus 06 plus 37. Over. [Long pause.]

a13_0024834.speaker: Haise
a13_0024834.text: Okay. If I heard those right, Joe, that the S-IVB maneuver was 2 plus 56 plus 57, and Sep time is 3 plus 06 plus 27.

a13_0024834.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0024834.text: Correction on the seconds; 2 plus 56 plus 37, and 3 plus 06 plus 37. [Long pause.]

a13_0024834.speaker: Haise
a13_0024834.text: Okay. 2 plus 56 plus 37 with the maneuver time; and the Sep time, 3 plus 06 plus 27?

a13_0024834.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0024834.text: That's plus 37, too. Exactly 10 minutes later, Fred.

a13_0025752.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0025752.text: We see the booster doing all the right things, and FIDO says your trajectory looks good, and it looks like we'll stick with a pretty close to nominal midcourse, too. We'll have some numbers for you later.

a13_0025752.speaker: Lovell
a13_0025752.text: Okay. And we concur. The S-IVB is maneuvering at this time.

a13_0025752.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0025752.text: And, Apollo 13, Houston. We'd like Omni Alpha. Over.

a13_0025752.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0025752.text: And, 13, we'll be doing a handover, now.

a13_0025752.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0025752.text: Apollo 13, Houston. You are Go for T&D.

a13_0025752.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0025752.text: And, 13, Houston. Check your Noun 17 for extraction pitch attitude. It should be 319 degrees. Over.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Okay, Houston; 13. Do we have a Go for pyro arm? [Pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: 13, Houston. Affirmative. You're Go for pyro arm, and recommend you secure the cabin pressurization.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: We did. We closed the waste management vent valve, there. Or waste stowage valves...

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Okay. We're reading 6 psi on the cabin, Jack. [Pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Roger, Joe. Thank you very much.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Yeah, that's quite a bang, Joe. We've separated, and we've pitched around about 60 degrees now.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Roger, Jack. We see you pitching.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Okay. We got the SLA panels; one of them is out front now.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Ah, so. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Got the S-IVB. I guess we're about 80 feet.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Good deal. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay. I'm going to come on with the TV now, Joe.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Okay, Fred. We're waiting for it. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: 13, Houston. We've got a groovy TV picture.

a13_0030520.speaker: Lovell
a13_0030520.text: Sounds good.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Is the focus good enough, Joe, that you can see all the glittering debris?

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: We've seen some debris, Fred. The booster itself is a little bit bright. What's your f-stop?

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay. I'm at 22.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Why don't you go up a click and let us have a look at that. [Pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay. You're at 44 now.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Okay. Let's stay there for now and I assume you're in peak.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Affirmed. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: 13, Houston. Recommend Rate 2 on the BMAGs.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Thank you. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: It's getting bigger. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Lovell
a13_0030520.text: As you might know, Joe, I've got the center seat, again and I can't see a thing.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Too bad.

a13_0030520.speaker: Lovell
a13_0030520.text: I gave him the TV monitor.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay, I'm going to be moving the TV directly. I'm going to pull it out of this bracket, Jim.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: 13, Houston. Did you call?

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Rog. I'll be moving the TV to get a better shot here; moving it out of this bracket.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Okay, Fred. It's just beginning to cut off at the bottom, but it's still a very good picture.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: That's a good picture, Fred.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: And we're just about there. About 10 - 10 more feet now.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Rog.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Everything looks pretty good down in the S-IVB, too. The shroud still looks intact down there.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Good deal. There's really quite a bit of detail in this picture. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Okay. We've - we've got two barber poles.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Houston; Roger. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay. You should be able to see down into the portion of the IU right now, Joe. [Pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Fred, Houston. We'd like to try going to Average on the TV for a minute or so.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay. You've got Average, and a little yellow dust cap just floated by in front of us.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Yeah. We see it at the top of the screen.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: And, Fred, after a few minutes of this, at your convenience, we could use some interior shots if you get the time and if the lighting is good.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: And, 13, Houston. The S-IVB vent times are nominal as in the Flight Plan within a few seconds. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Lovell
a13_0030520.text: We're hard docked, Houston.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Roger. Understand. Hard docked. Good deal. Fred, one more thing on the TV. If you could come down to f:22 again.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay. You've got f:22 again. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Lovell
a13_0030520.text: And, Houston, Fred will handle the camera as we go through the postdocking checklist.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Okay, Jim. Real good.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay, Joe. I am pointing it over toward Jack, and it's pretty bright with the Earth out that window. Is that sort of washing out the picture here?

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: No, Fred, it's not. We've got a bright spot where the window is. The rest of you are semi-silhouetted. It's a pretty impressive picture. [Long pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Apollo 13, Houston.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Go ahead, Joe.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: For Fred. The IOS [?] has caught you with the fuel cell reactant valves in latch again. [Pause.]

a13_0030520.speaker: Lovell
a13_0030520.text: Touché.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: And we have word that the propellant usage for T&D was nominal.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Okay, what is nominal, please?

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Well, I didn't ask that yet, Jack; stand by one.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: That's okay (laughter).

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Fred, this is Houston. Over.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Go ahead.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: Okay. With the direct sunlight from the window, out of the TV camera field as it is now, we'd like you to open it up an f-stop or so and, if convenient, try to keep that bright spot out of the window.

a13_0030520.speaker: Haise
a13_0030520.text: Okay.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: 13, Houston. I guess we think we could stand one more click down on the f-stop.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: Okay, Joe. He's going to do it.

a13_0030520.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0030520.text: That is, we want you to open it up. Looks like a very interesting book you're reading.

a13_0030520.speaker: Swigert
a13_0030520.text: I've got two of them.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Hey, that's pretty, Fred.

a13_0033011.speaker: Haise
a13_0033011.text: Okay. I hope you got more detail than I have on the monitor here.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: No. We probably don't, but it's kind of a neat picture anyway. [Long pause.]

a13_0033011.speaker: Swigert
a13_0033011.text: Houston, we're now going to finish repressurizing the tunnel.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Houston; Roger.

a13_0033011.speaker: Haise
a13_0033011.text: [garbled] probably hear, Joe, we're just finishing pumping up Aquarius here.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Okay. About all we see on this picture, Fred, are the bright spots with the lights around the tunnel area. The hatch itself is pretty dark.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: 13, Houston. By the way, we'd like to know how the High Gain Antenna lockup worked. Our signal strength is a little bit lower than we thought it would be.

a13_0033011.speaker: Swigert
a13_0033011.text: It looked just the way I expected it to, Joe. I had her sitting there in Reacq with the numbers cranked in and soon as we got pretty much through the rotation, I just threw it down to High Gain and it appeared to lock right up.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Okay. Good deal. See that flashlight beam wandering around there.

a13_0033011.speaker: Haise
a13_0033011.text: Houston, 13.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: 13, Houston. Go ahead.

a13_0033011.speaker: Haise
a13_0033011.text: We'd kind of like to hold off on the - start the venting again until we get the things pumped back up inside here. Wonder if you might give us a call to remind us when to initiate that.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Okay, 13; will do. [Long pause.]

a13_0033011.speaker: Haise
a13_0033011.text: And we'll try to shift her up to look up into the tunnel here.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Okay. Real good. [Long pause.]

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Okay, 13; Houston. I think we could use an f-stop lower. What f-stop are you in now?

a13_0033011.speaker: Haise
a13_0033011.text: I'm about as low as you can go, Joe. I'm sitting on 4.4.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Okay. [Pause.]

a13_0033011.speaker: Haise
a13_0033011.text: What you're looking at, Joe, is the commander has removed the hatch and is proceeding to stow it. [Long pause.]

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Okay, 13. That's a pretty good picture there.

a13_0033011.speaker: Haise
a13_0033011.text: The CDR is verifying the docking latches now.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Rog. [Pause.]

a13_0033011.speaker: Swigert
a13_0033011.text: Hey, Joe. Jim reports that there's a slight, you know, burn smell up in the tunnel area, as been reported on previous flights.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Okay. We copy that. [Long pause.]

a13_0033011.speaker: Swigert
a13_0033011.text: Okay. The commander reports all docking latches latched.

a13_0033011.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0033011.text: Houston; Roger.

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: 13, Houston. For your information, the S-IVB vent is proceeding on schedule.

a13_0034129.speaker: Swigert
a13_0034129.text: Okay, Joe.

a13_0034129.speaker: Haise
a13_0034129.text: Yeah, Joe. That's - That's concurring with all the thousands of particles I see going by outside here.

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: Yes. I guess I didn't need to tell you.

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: 13. Looks like Jim is connecting the umbilical at this time. Is that right?

a13_0034129.speaker: Haise
a13_0034129.text: Yeah, that's affirm - affirm, Joe. Do you have any detail up in there at all? On the monitor it looks like I can - I can make out the drogue - the drogue a little bit, but not much else.

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: We can see the probe pretty well, and we can see his hands quite well there.

a13_0034129.speaker: Swigert
a13_0034129.text: Okay. We're powering the LM now, Joe.

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: Okay, Roger that. [Long pause.]

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: And the voltage looks good there, 13.

a13_0034129.speaker: Swigert
a13_0034129.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a13_0034129.speaker: Haise
a13_0034129.text: Okay. We're going to take an outside view now, out the left side, Joe.

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: Okay, Fred. Real good. [Long pause.]

a13_0034129.speaker: Haise
a13_0034129.text: Okay. You making out the picture up there, Joe?

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: Yeah. Is that the world? [Pause.]

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: Okay, Fred. That's a pretty nice looking picture. We'd like to know what settings you used to get that.

a13_0034129.speaker: Haise
a13_0034129.text: Okay. I think Jim's holding it now and - it - Okay, it should be in about f:22, infinity, and I think the 50-millimeter. And Jim says he thinks he has Baja in the picture now.

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: Okay. I think we could stand to go to f:44 on that. The clouds are pretty bright.

a13_0034129.speaker: Haise
a13_0034129.text: Okay. We're going to have to press on here, Joe, so we're back inside.

a13_0034129.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0034129.text: Okay. Thanks a lot.

a13_0035404.speaker: Haise
a13_0035404.text: Okay. How's that picture looking back outside now, Joe? Getting ready for LM extraction.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Okay. That looks pretty good, Fred. [Long pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Lovell
a13_0035404.text: Houston, this is 13. Do we have a Go for pyro arm?

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: 13, Houston. Affirmative. You're Go for pyro arm. [Long pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Swigert
a13_0035404.text: Hey, Joe, when we went back up and rechecked the tunnel there, we found two latches that weren't cocked and we reset them.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Ah, Roger that, Jack. [Long pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Swigert
a13_0035404.text: Joe, I've got a beautiful view of the Earth out window 1.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Roger, Jack.

a13_0035404.speaker: Haise
a13_0035404.text: By the way, the windows came through in real good shape. Window 5 looks real clean, so I'm kind of hopeful that Hycon stuff will be pretty good.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Good deal. [Pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Haise
a13_0035404.text: I meant window 3, Joe. [Long pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Okay, 13; Houston. You're Go for LM SEP whenever you're ready.

a13_0035404.speaker: Lovell
a13_0035404.text: Roger. [Pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Okay, 13; Houston. Correction on that. You're Go for LM SEP at the nominal time and - or later. We don't want it early.

a13_0035404.speaker: Lovell
a13_0035404.text: Okay, Joe. We'll do it at 04:01:00.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Roger.

a13_0035404.speaker: Swigert
a13_0035404.text: Okay. We're about ready to pull the LM out, Joe.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Okay, 13.

a13_0035404.speaker: Swigert
a13_0035404.text: Here she comes. [Pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Swigert
a13_0035404.text: Okay. It looks like we're clear, Joe.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Okay. Looks good. It's weird because we get the TV about 10 seconds after you call it.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Apollo 13, Houston.

a13_0035404.speaker: Lovell
a13_0035404.text: Go ahead.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Okay. We'll be waiting for you to tell us that you feel you're safely clear of the booster, and give us the Go to command the booster in its yaw maneuver.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: 13, Houston. Did you - did you copy my last about giving us a Go for the yaw?

a13_0035404.speaker: Haise
a13_0035404.text: Yeah, we're maneuvering, Joe, and we hadn't picked her back up again yet.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Okay. Do you want to wait till you acquire it before we yaw it?

a13_0035404.speaker: Lovell
a13_0035404.text: How much time do you have, Houston? Can you wait, or do you want to do it right now?

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: We can wait if you want us to, Jim. [Pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Lovell
a13_0035404.text: Why don't you wait just a little bit.

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a13_0035404.speaker: Swigert
a13_0035404.text: Joe, did they ever get an idea of what that - the TD and E fuel was?

a13_0035404.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0035404.text: Jack, they're not willing to pin it down to a specific number right now because they say the tanks will warm up later on and the apparent consumption will go down. But it was nominal.

a13_0035404.speaker: Swigert
a13_0035404.text: Okay.

a13_0040826.speaker: Swigert
a13_0040826.text: Okay, Houston. We have the S-IVB in sight. You're Go to maneuver the S-IVB.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Houston, Roger that. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Swigert
a13_0040826.text: We'll try to give you a - Houston, we're going to try to give you a shot of the S-IVB with the TV out window number 3.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Okay. Real good, Jack. Our S-band signal strength has been fluctuating. Does it seem to be going all right up there in the Auto Track mode ?

a13_0040826.speaker: Haise
a13_0040826.text: Yeah. Right now; yes, it's dropped off to about the 70-percent point, Joe, and it was before up about 85.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Lovell
a13_0040826.text: And, Houston, do you have a TV picture?

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Not at the moment, Jim. We had a garbled one there for a few seconds, and we don't have one at this moment.

a13_0040826.speaker: Lovell
a13_0040826.text: Okay. I can see the S-IVB now out the hatch window and it's...

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Okay, Jim. Suddenly we have a very good picture.

a13_0040826.speaker: Lovell
a13_0040826.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Lovell
a13_0040826.text: And, Houston, I can see the gold shroud around the IU, and it looks that it's all intact.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Roger, Jim. We copy that. Incidentally, the APS evasive maneuver will be about 4 minutes late. It'll be at about 04 plus 18.

a13_0040826.speaker: Lovell
a13_0040826.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: 13, Houston. Wonder if you could zoom in on that S-IVB for us a little bit?

a13_0040826.speaker: Lovell
a13_0040826.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Yeah, yeah. More like that. [Pause.] That's nice. [Pause.] It's off our screen to the right, now. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Oh, that's very nice, very nice. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Swigert
a13_0040826.text: Okay, Joe. Is EECOM monitoring the O 2 Flow High light again? We - we haven't yet started the venting yet.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Okay. Stand by. I'll check. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: 13, Houston.

a13_0040826.speaker: Swigert
a13_0040826.text: Go ahead.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Jack, your cabin Regs are still making up, but you're Go to open the waste management vent again at this time, and we'll delta the time to close it by the appropriate amount for you.

a13_0040826.speaker: Swigert
a13_0040826.text: Okay. Real fine. Well, we'll wait till the S-IVB does its maneuver here.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Okay.

a13_0040826.speaker: Haise
a13_0040826.text: Okay, Joe. We just had a momentary drop off in signal strength again there.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Roger, Fred. We had an LOS for a minute and we lost our TV picture. It looks like - yeah, we just got it back. It looks great again.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: 13, Houston. You might stop the f-stop down one more notch, if you got any left. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: And, 13, Houston. We'll be commanding the evasive maneuver in about 17 seconds. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Swigert
a13_0040826.text: Okay, Joe. We can see it start to move. However, it doesn't seem to be a lot of debris or vapor coming out of it.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Roger that, Jack. Booster says that's great. He says the booster's doing its thing normally. Concur. We don't see much on the television at all. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: And, Apollo 13, Houston. We'd like to change the S-band antenna configuration. Like you to go Omni Delta. Like you to go Manual mode on the High Gain with pitch of minus 60 and yaw of 90. Over.

a13_0040826.speaker: Haise
a13_0040826.text: Okay. You want us to Omni Delta and Manual on the High Gain to minus 60 and plus 90. Is that correct?

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: That's affirmative. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Swigert
a13_0040826.text: Okay, Houston. How much longer would you like the television?

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Stand by on that. We'll get a word.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Okay, 13; this is Houston. You can turn the TV off anytime you're ready. We've enjoyed the show. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: 13, Houston. Before you secure the TV, we'd like to know whether that was in maximum zoom, just for information.

a13_0040826.speaker: Haise
a13_0040826.text: That's affirm. Jim had it in Max zoom.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Okay. Good deal. That was a real good picture. [Long pause.]

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: And, 13, Houston. The APS evasive maneuver appeared to be nominal. The LOX dump time is now 4 plus 39 plus 20, about 3 minutes late.

a13_0040826.speaker: Lovell
a13_0040826.text: Roger.

a13_0040826.speaker: Swigert
a13_0040826.text: Okay, Joe. We're right now opening the Waste Stowage Vent.

a13_0040826.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0040826.text: Okay, Jack. We copy. [Long pause.]

a13_0043047.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0043047.text: Apollo 13, Houston. Request Omni Alpha now. Over.

a13_0043700.speaker: Young
a13_0043700.text: Roger. They are having trouble verifying that the High Gain is doing its thing. Like to verify that the pitch is minus 10, the Y is plus 350, you're in Wide Beam Width and Auto. [Pause.]

a13_0043700.speaker: Haise
a13_0043700.text: Okay. Minus 10 pitch, plus 350 yaw, and Wide Beam Width and going into Auto. You want High Gain, John?

a13_0043700.speaker: Haise
a13_0043700.text: Okay. Here, it's coming at you.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Haise
a13_0045043ag.text: Ah, Houston; 13.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: 13, Houston. Go ahead.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Haise
a13_0045043ag.text: Is the S-IVB doing something different now?

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Well, I don't know. It should be - let's see, it should have started the LOX dump at least quite a while ago. I guess that's complete. Why do you ask, Fred?

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Haise
a13_0045043ag.text: I'm looking out window 5 at what I think is the S-IVB, and I'm seeing what looks to be double plumes, growing in - it's two very narrow bands, maybe about 3 degrees, that are streaming out from it. And then there is a less dense band that covers maybe a 40-degree swath through the sky that continues out, also, in two directions.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0045043ag.text: Hey, Joe, what it looks like, kind of, is if you pull up behind a guy that's pulling a contrail, and you get in his contrail, like he's going away from you - there's a long contrail.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay; stand by. Let me see what Frank's got to say about that.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Haise
a13_0045043ag.text: Except we're between - Looks like we're between two contrails, one guy above and one below.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Roger. [Pause.]

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Haise
a13_0045043ag.text: It's a very pretty sight. [Long pause.]

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay, 13; Houston. The booster says that the propulsive dump is concluded; he now has the nonpropulsive vents open and what you see is a normal phenomenon and it should go on for another 5 minutes or so.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Haise
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: And, while I've got you, 13, at your convenience, we'd like to have the results of the EMS bias tests that you did pre-TLI and pre-Sep.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0045043ag.text: Stand by.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay, Joe. The TLI - the Delta-V no-bias test prior to TLI, we had a 0.8, and post-TLI, it was 1.0.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay, Jack. Copy that. Thank you very much. Incidentally, as your tracking gets better and better, the size of MCC-2 is getting lower and lower and figures to be somewhere between 10 and 30 feet per second now.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0045043ag.text: Sounds good.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Yeah, sure does. [Long pause.]

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0045043ag.text: Go ahead, Joe.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay. We have a PTC REFSMMAT ready, if you're ready to go P00 and Accept, we'll stick it in there.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay. Stand by.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay. I'm P00 and Accept, Joe.

a13_0045043ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045043ag.text: Okay. Roger that.

a13_0045800.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045800.text: Apollo 13, Houston. We'll have a handover in half a minute or so. You may get a momentary loss of strength.

a13_0045902ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045902ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. We'll have a handover in half a minute or so. You may get a momentary loss of strength.

a13_0045902ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0045902ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. The computer is yours. Over.

a13_0053013.speaker: Swigert
a13_0053013.text: Okay, Houston. Do you copy 13's torqueing angles on the P52?

a13_0053013.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0053013.text: 13, Houston. Leave them up just a second, and we'll get them down.

a13_0053013.speaker: Swigert
a13_0053013.text: Okay. The time of torqueing was 5 hours, 30 minutes and 40 seconds.

a13_0053947.speaker: Lovell
a13_0053947.text: Okay. I just got all hooked up to get in my comm system here, and I just wanted to check out. I've got my suit stowed, a few other odds and ends done, and I'm back in business again.

a13_0053947.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0053947.text: Okay. Good deal. We're kind of hanging loose down here. I've got a Lift-off plus 15 PAD. There's no hurry to read it up, so let us know when you're ready.

a13_0053947.speaker: Lovell
a13_0053947.text: Okay, Houston. Go ahead with the PAD.

a13_0053947.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0053947.text: Okay, Jim. Lift-off plus 15 PAD: GET I , 015:00; Delta-V T , 5622; longitude, minus 165; and GET 400K, 047:04. Over. [Pause.]

a13_0053947.speaker: Lovell
a13_0053947.text: Okay, Houston. Lift-off plus 15: GET I , 015:00; 5622; minus 165; 047:04. Is that correct?

a13_0055445.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0055445.text: Rog. We'd like to have the Attitude Set switch back to GDC, if you're finished with your align. It gives G&C down here a telemetry problem.

a13_0055445.speaker: Swigert
a13_0055445.text: I'm just going to give them one more align here.

a13_0061540.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0061540.text: Rog. Would you please verify or tell us what S-band antenna configuration you're in, please?

a13_0061540.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0061540.text: Roger. Stand by a minute, Jim. Our signal strength is getting a little low. We may have a recommendation. [Pause.]

a13_0061540.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0061540.text: 13, Houston. Are you in Manual or Auto in High Gain?

a13_0061540.speaker: Lovell
a13_0061540.text: Stand by. [Pause.] We're in Auto Track, Joe, and High Gain.

a13_0064430.speaker: Swigert
a13_0064430.text: Hey, were you copying my P23 results?

a13_0064430.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0064430.text: That's affirmative, Jack. We followed you through the whole thing. You're ahead of schedule, hey.

a13_0064430.speaker: Lovell
a13_0064430.text: And, Joe, we confirmed there's no midcourse-1. Over.

a13_0064430.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0064430.text: That is affirmative as far as I know. Let's get a final check on it, Jim.

a13_0064430.speaker: Lovell
a13_0064430.text: Okay. Because we're standing by. We want to do a fuel cell purge and a waste water dump.

a13_0064430.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0064430.text: Okay, Jim. We confirm that there will be no midcourse-1.

a13_0064430.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0064430.text: And, 13, Houston. You can go ahead with the purge and dump at your discretion.

a13_0064430.speaker: Lovell
a13_0064430.text: Roger, Houston. What we're going to do is, we're going to get rid of Fred's suit here. Fred's suit has been right in the commander's slot here for the last half hour. So we're going to try and get it stowed.

a13_0064430.speaker: Lovell
a13_0064430.text: You did a pretty good job.

a13_0064912ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0064912ag.text: Apollo 13, Houston. We'll have a handover in about 1 minute.

a13_0064912ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0064912ag.text: Roger, Jim. We'll have a handover from Hawaii to Goldstone in about 30 seconds.

a13_0064912ag.speaker: Kerwin
a13_0064912ag.text: We'll be handing over from Hawaii to Goldstone in a few seconds. You may get a temporary loss of comm.

a13_0064912ag.speaker: Lovell
a13_0064912ag.text: Okay, Houston. We've got a whole bunch of noise, too.

a13_0065923ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0065923ag.text: Hey, Joe. Do you want to dump waste water down to 25 percent. Is that right?

a13_0065923ag.speaker: Swigert
a13_0065923ag.text: Do you know we're also purging fuel cells O 2 now.

a13_0070900.speaker: Swigert
a13_0070900.text: Okay, Houston. The fuel cell purge and waste water dump are complete.

a13_0070900.speaker: Brand
a13_0070900.text: Roger, Apollo 13. And this is your relief CapCom shift on now.

a13_0070900.speaker: Swigert
a13_0070900.text: Boy, you sure made it back fast.

a13_0070900.speaker: Brand
a13_0070900.text: Yes. You guys had a beautiful launch, there. Really nice. [Pause.]

a13_0070900.speaker: Swigert
a13_0070900.text: Could you follow it all the way up, Vance?

a13_0070900.speaker: Brand
a13_0070900.text: No, I didn't see staging. It was too hazy for that, but we could see it for a few miles anyway. [Pause.]

a13_0071700.speaker: Lovell
a13_0071700.text: Roger. We're at that stage now where we're going to take some Earth weather photography. If you're standing by, I have the camera aimed at the Earth right now, and I'll give you a mark when I take the first picture.

a13_0071700.speaker: Brand
a13_0071700.text: Roger. We copy, Jim. We'll be standing by for the mark. [Long pause.]

a13_0071700.speaker: Brand
a13_0071700.text: For the PTC, recommend that you disable quads A and B. Over.

a13_0071700.speaker: Lovell
a13_0071700.text: Okay. Disable quads A and B, will do; and soon as Jack gets finished thrashing around, we'll be going to that PTC mode.

a13_0073129.speaker: Lovell
a13_0073129.text: Okay, Houston. We're starting PTC. We're disabling quads A and B now.

a13_0073129.speaker: Brand
a13_0073129.text: Jim, we'd like to verify that the High Gain is secured, that the S-band antenna is on Omni, and Omni B should be the right antenna. Over.

a13_0073129.speaker: Lovell
a13_0073129.text: Okay. You want the High Gain secured and you want the Omni on Omni Charlie, huh? Or Baker?

a13_0073129.speaker: Brand
a13_0073129.text: That's affirm. And this'll be maintained in the PTC.

a13_0073129.speaker: Brand
a13_0073129.text: And the High Gain angles for stowage - or for stowing - are pitch minus 52, yaw 270.

a13_0073921.speaker: Lovell
a13_0073921.text: Stand by for another Earth weather picture. I'll give you a mark.

a13_0073921.speaker: Brand
a13_0073921.text: Houston here. Your rates look very stable. It looks like your rates are damped out completely here. As far as we can see, it would be alright to start the PTC.

a13_0073921.speaker: Lovell
a13_0073921.text: Okay. We'll give it a try.

a13_0075429.speaker: Haise
a13_0075429.text: Hello, Houston. This is 13. How do you read?

a13_0075429.speaker: Brand
a13_0075429.text: 13; Houston. Loud and clear. [Pause.] 13, Houston's reading loud and clear. How do you read?

a13_0075429.speaker: Haise
a13_0075429.text: Okay. And do you have any estimate, Vance, on how long we'll be charging battery B?

a13_0075429.speaker: Brand
a13_0075429.text: We'll be charging for 4½ to 5 hours yet, Jim.

a13_0080233.speaker: Brand
a13_0080233.text: Aah, Fred, recommend that, when your window comes around facing the Earth again, that you catch another one of those pictures, and at the same time, you should probably start PTC again. We might have sent a confusing bit of info up to you. The 'disable two quads' only applies to an early step in the procedure. We didn't mean that for the latter part of the procedure where we have the statement 'enable all jets.' Over.

a13_0080733.speaker: Swigert
a13_0080733.text: Vance, Fred said that you had some more information about PTC and a different way of establishing it or something, huh?

a13_0080733.speaker: Brand
a13_0080733.text: Rog. Referring to the procedure on G/8-2, if you have that open, I'll tell you what we had to give you. [Pause.]

a13_0080733.speaker: Swigert
